name: Sofia Rodriguez
psychographics: Idealistic and creatively driven; lives for the 'aesthetic' of cheap experiences, often sacrifices practicality for vibe
current_solutions: Relies on UniStudent discount codes for Uber Eats, uses Spotify Premium Family shared across cousins, buys second-hand textbooks from a Facebook group called 'Uni Textbooks Melbourne'
frustration: Woke up at 7am to claim the 8am early-bird cinema ticket for $12, but the online system crashed at 7:05am and by the time it recovered, the 8am session was sold out, leaving me to pay $22 for a standard ticket
decision_style: Impulse-buys festival tickets during late-night study sessions, then regrets it when rent is due, often trades items with flatmates instead of buying new
voice: Rambling, poetic, uses a lot of 'like' and 'literally'. Frequently pauses mid-sentence to check if something is 'cringe'
